name: Indian Sign Language
alphabet_description: ISL utilizes a distinct fingerspelling system influenced by both regional conventions and two-handed configurations for consonants, with specific orientations for vowels.

alphabet.description: Closed fist with thumb upright alongside the index finger.
Flat non-dominant hand touched at palm by dominant flat hand forming a B shape.
Curved C-shape formed by fingers and thumb.
Non-dominant index pointing up, dominant curved fingers completing the loop.
Dominant index pointing to middle knuckle of non-dominant hand.

vocabulary.label: HELLO
vocabulary.description: Dominant open hand placed near forehead/temple and arced smoothly outward in greeting.

vocabulary.label: GOODBYE
vocabulary.description: Open hand raised at chest level oscillating side to side.

vocabulary.label: THANK_YOU
vocabulary.description: Flat open hand touching chin/mouth, moving gently outward toward person.
vocabulary.hand_orientation: palm inward touching chin, then tilting forward

vocabulary.label: PLEASE
vocabulary.description: Open flat palm gently rubbing in a circular motion on the chest.

vocabulary.label: SORRY
vocabulary.description: Closed fist gently rotating over the heart/chest area.

vocabulary.label: HELP
vocabulary.description: Non-dominant flat palm facing up; dominant fist with thumb upright placed on palm and lifted together.
vocabulary.hand_orientation: base palm up, top hand fist with thumb up

vocabulary.label: YES
vocabulary.description: Fist held upright and tilted forward/downward in an affirmative nod.

vocabulary.label: NO
vocabulary.description: Index and middle fingers snapping or pressing against the thumb horizontally.
vocabulary.hand_orientation: fingers extended then snapping to thumb

vocabulary.label: WATER
vocabulary.description: Hand forming a 'W' or cup shape tapping gently at the corner of the mouth/chin.

vocabulary.label: FOOD
vocabulary.description: Flattened O-shape hand brought repeatedly near the mouth.

vocabulary.label: I
vocabulary.description: Index finger pointing directly at the center of the chest.

vocabulary.label: YOU
vocabulary.description: Index finger pointing forward directly toward conversational partner/camera.

vocabulary.label: MY
vocabulary.description: Open flat palm placed gently flat on the center of the chest.

vocabulary.label: WHAT
vocabulary.description: Both open hands held out with palms facing upward, shaking gently side to side.

vocabulary.label: WHERE
vocabulary.description: Index finger pointed upward, wagging gently left to right in an inquiring motion.
